content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification:** deviation (walk-away territory) at § 2.1 (p0012).

**Why:** The clause is a multi-year (three-year) USD 2,000,000-per-year take-or-pay obligation expressly "without reduction or termination rights" — it fails every fallback element (no 12-month limit, no reduction on 30 days' notice, no true-up instead of a penalty) and contradicts § 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment. No other clause imposes a volume floor or usage cap on us (§ 7.1 in fact bars unidentified minimum-use charges, and § 8.3 concerns only renewal uplift).

**Cure:** One surgical replace of § 2.1 with the preferred position — no minimum purchase or volume commitment, and payment only for Services used or ordered — carrying both preferred elements and eliminating the internal conflict with § 12.3, with the 12-month/reducible/true-up fallback offered in the comment.
